messages:
Maria Gomez: starting 1% cohort run for v2.4-int4 on shadow-prod for longdoc + short-answer slices. watching MRR, hallucination_rate, latency_p95. will run for 24h then eval. please don't promote manually. :eyes:

Kai Liu: are we routing by user cohort or endpoint? need to make sure session affinity doesn't leak kv-cache warmup bias.

Maria Gomez: routing by endpoint with cohort id header x-rwd-cohort=cohesion-1. no session pinning. KV warmup planned.

Raj Patel: set autofallback thresholds: if MRR drops >= 1.5% absolute OR hallucination_rate increases by >0.4pp across sampled slices -> auto-fallback. also trigger if latency_p95 increases > 60ms.

Sasha R.: sample plan? how many requests per slice needed to be confident on binomial test?

Maria Gomez: aiming for 30k examples per slice (we expect ~1.2M total in 24h). we'll run two-sided binomial with alpha=0.01 and also check concordance with our rerank metric.

Jordana: add kv warmup job: `rwdctl warmup --pool cohort-cohesion --prefetch=1000 --seqlen=4096` (running now)

deploy-bot: shadow deployment v2.4-int4 -> SUCCESS on 12 nodes. stream-id: s-5009997777

Kai Liu: can we log the cohort header to trace_id mapping? want to sanity-check nondeterministic routing.

Raj Patel: added alert rule: `alert: CohortMRRDrop
expr: rate(mrr_delta{cohort="cohesion-1"}[15m]) > 0.015
for: 10m` notify #eng-oncall + #eng-ml

Maria Gomez: cool. will post a short A/B summary after 24h with sample slices and p-values. thanks all. :thumbsup:
